senses.gloss:
भोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
 1. To be used or enjoyed.
 2. To be eaten. E.
भुज् to eat, &c., तव्य aff.

भोक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्ती-क्तृ)
 1. Enjoying, an enjoyer.
 2. An eater.
 m. (-क्ता)
 1.
A husband.
 2. A lover.
 3. A possessor.
 4. A king.
 E. भुज् to enjoy,
&c., aff. तृच् ।

भोक्तृत्व n. (-त्वं) Possession, enjoyment.
 E. त्व added to the last.

भोक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being about to eat.
 E. भुज् to eat, and शानच्
aff., here of the future tense.
